mapper.select: SELECT a.*,b.aname,b.desc,b.usernum FROM collection a,area b where a.area=b.id and a.deleted=1 and a.uid=#{id}
SELECT a.*,b.aname,b.desc,b.usernum FROM collection a,area b WHERE a.area=b.id and a.deleted = 1 AND DATE(time) = Date(#{day})
SELECT a.*,b.aname,b.desc,b.usernum FROM collection a,area b WHERE a.area=b.id and a.deleted = 1 AND DATE(time) = CURDATE()
